visual.general_description: Three frontal chest radiographs labelled a, b and c side by side.
visual.detailed_description: Three grayscale frontal chest radiographs arranged left to right with panel letters a, b and c at the upper left of each. Panel a has a small letter R and the word Upright printed near its upper left corner. Panel b shows diffuse hazy opacities in both lung fields; panel c shows clearer lung fields with thin line-like shadows and small round dense markers over both sides of the upper chest, the more conspicuous one on the right side of the image.

panels.general_description: Frontal chest radiograph labelled a, with a small letter R and the word Upright at the upper left.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale frontal chest radiograph. A small white letter R and a smaller word reading Upright are printed near the upper left corner. Both lung fields and the rib cage are visible, with the heart and mediastinum centrally and the diaphragm and upper abdomen at the bottom, where rounded gas-like lucencies are seen. The lower lung zones appear hazier than the upper zones. Thin linear shadows cross the upper chest at the left of the image. The panel letter a is printed at the upper left of the figure.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Grayscale frontal projection of the chest showing ribs, lungs, mediastinum and diaphragm

visual.general_description: Two stacked twelve-lead electrocardiogram tracings labelled a and b.
visual.detailed_description: Two electrocardiogram printouts stacked vertically, a above b, each in a two-column layout of six lead rows with lead labels and calibration pulses. Complexes are spaced further apart in a than in b.

panels.detailed_description: Twelve-lead tracing on grid paper in a two-column layout. The left column is labelled I, II, III, aVR, aVL and aVF and the right column is labelled V1 to V6. Rectangular calibration pulses appear at the left end of each row. Complexes repeat regularly across each strip, are spaced further apart than in panel b, and the V1 to V3 rows show tall downward deflections. The panel letter a is printed at the upper left.

measured_quantities.visual_cue: Lead-labelled tracings on ECG grid paper

limitations: No printed paper speed, gain, rate or interval values are visible, so no rate or interval was read from the tracing.
